result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway with inadequate crossing infrastructure. While a sidewalk and curb ramp are present on one side, the lack of clear crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals creates a high-risk environment for crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of visible crosswalk markings on a wide, multi-lane road increases the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts.

hazards.name: Vehicle Encroachment
hazards.description: A vehicle is stopped directly in the area where a pedestrian would cross, forcing them into traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Red car in the center right

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines.

result.summary: The intersection is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and continuous sidewalks. The wide roadway and lack of crossing infrastructure prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians with no designated space to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian signal heads are visible, meaning people walking have no indication of when it is safe to cross relative to traffic phases.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Pedestrian Path
hazards.description: There is no formal sidewalk on either side of the roadway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the street or on unpaved shoulders.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk network on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

result.summary: The intersection is dominated by a wide, multi-lane roadway with no visible pedestrian crossings or signals for the main thoroughfare. While a crosswalk exists on a side street, the overall environment is hostile to pedestrians due to high exposure and lack of protective infrastructure.

hazards.name: Missing Main Road Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks across the primary multi-lane roadway, forcing unsafe mid-block crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the wide roadway in the center and left of the frame.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks pedestrian-specific signals, leaving walkers without clear guidance on when to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: At all corners of the intersection.

hazards.name: High Speed Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and large turning radii encourage high vehicle speeds through the intersection.

interventions.title: Comprehensive Crosswalk Marking
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to provide legal and safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signalization
interventions.description: Add pedestrian countdown signals and push buttons to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps, but pedestrians must cross a wide, multi-lane roadway with significant exposure. The environment is dominated by vehicle-centric design, including overhead traffic signals and wide lanes that likely encourage higher speeds.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for an extended period while crossing the multi-lane road.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Sun glare
hazards.description: The low sun angle creates significant glare, potentially reducing driver visibility of pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Upper left quadrant of the image

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.
